name: Dro'zakar
location: Moongrave Fane, Fane of Waning Moons

abilities.name: Blood Mist
abilities.description: Dro'zakar disappears and swirling blood fumes appear in his place and starts chasing players, indicated by a moving AoE, dealing continuous damage.

abilities.name: Blood Drain
abilities.description: Targeted ability that leeches health from one player

abilities.name: Sangiin Shield
abilities.description: After every Helot consumption phase, he gains a damage shield similar to Zhaj'hassa the Forgotten, where he deals continuous damage to the group as he shields himself. The group must dps his shield down as the healer keeps everyone alive.

abilities.name: Consume Hemo Helot
abilities.description: A group of Sacrificial Helots rush into the arena and sacrifice themselves to create an Hemo Helot. When Dro'zakar begins to feed on the Hemo Helot, one group member must destroy it to stop him from becoming empowered. This can be done easily with a heavy attack. If he manages to consume a hemo helot, Dro'zakar will deal massive damage to the group.

abilities.name: Red Breath
abilities.description: Dro'zakar sprays a blood breath attack in a cone in front of him, dealing high magic damage and stunning targets hit.

abilities.name: Summon Allies
abilities.description: Other Hollowfang Clan enemies will rush into the arena to assist Dro'zakar during the boss fight.

dialogue.speaker: Dro'zakar
dialogue.line: You are not the skulking rat, but you are my prey all the same.

dialogue.speaker: Dro'zakar
dialogue.line: Dro'zakar will taste your blood before the Dragon's. He is always hungry.

dialogue.speaker: Dro'zakar
dialogue.line: Show the Clan Mother your worth!

dialogue.speaker: Dro'zakar
dialogue.line: Feel your pulse quicken ... and stop!

dialogue.speaker: Dro'zakar
dialogue.line: Can you feel your blood betraying you?

dialogue.speaker: Dro'zakar
dialogue.line: Do you hear the Doom Drum growing louder in your ears?

dialogue.speaker: Dro'zakar
dialogue.line: Your heart will beat to bursting!

dialogue.speaker: Dro'zakar
dialogue.line: I'll seep into your veins.

dialogue.speaker: Dro'zakar
dialogue.line: Am I too slippery?

dialogue.speaker: Dro'zakar
dialogue.line: You can't corner me.

dialogue.speaker: Dro'zakar
dialogue.line: Try not to slip.

dialogue.speaker: Dro'zakar
dialogue.line: Did you not wish to spill my blood?

dialogue.speaker: Dro'zakar
dialogue.line: Perhaps you should try a straw.

dialogue.speaker: Dro'zakar
dialogue.line: I'll drown you in blood.

dialogue.speaker: Dro'zakar
dialogue.line: Hah. I am not a solitary hunter.

dialogue.speaker: Dro'zakar
dialogue.line: Take a bite of my prey, blood-kin!

dialogue.speaker: Dro'zakar
dialogue.line: Herd them like the cattle they are!

dialogue.speaker: Dro'zakar
dialogue.line: Hollowfangs! Feast on these fools!

dialogue.speaker: Dro'zakar
dialogue.line: Hah! Swine that bleed themselves! You're only fit for slaughter!
dialogue.trigger: When a player or NPC bleeds to create a hemo helot

dialogue.speaker: Dro'zakar
dialogue.line: Your sacrifice is in vain.
dialogue.trigger: When a player or NPC bleeds to create a hemo helot

dialogue.speaker: Dro'zakar
dialogue.line: I accept you [sic] offering, but you'll still die.
dialogue.trigger: When a player or NPC bleeds to create a hemo helot

dialogue.speaker: Dro'zakar
dialogue.line: Keep your blood in your veins. I prefer to drink from your throats!
dialogue.trigger: When a player or NPC bleeds to create a hemo helot

dialogue.speaker: Dro'zakar
dialogue.line: I'll be taking this.
dialogue.trigger: When feeding on a hemo helot

dialogue.speaker: Dro'zakar
dialogue.line: Your blood has no power over me.
dialogue.trigger: When feeding on a hemo helot

dialogue.speaker: Dro'zakar
dialogue.line: Blood is too precious for you to waste.
dialogue.trigger: When feeding on a hemo helot

dialogue.speaker: Dro'zakar
dialogue.line: I'll drown you in blood.

dialogue.speaker: Dro'zakar
dialogue.line: You forgot something.

dialogue.speaker: Dro'zakar
dialogue.line: And here I was just toying with you.

dialogue.speaker: Dro'zakar
dialogue.line: I am embarrassed for you.

dialogue.speaker: Dro'zakar
dialogue.line: Feh. You taste of vermin.

dialogue.speaker: Dro'zakar
dialogue.line: The deer make better prey.

dialogue.speaker: Dro'zakar
dialogue.line: I'll leave your sluggish blood for the rats.

dialogue.speaker: Dro'zakar
dialogue.line: Dro'zakar is thirsty. Kind of you to offer your throats.
